$comment: RFC 0173 §A.1/§C — sideEffectSuppression is not a flag; suppression binds with replay and is witnessed by the effect-seam manifest at GET /host/effect-seams

modes.description: Fork modes (POST /runs/{runId}:fork `mode`): replay = deterministic re-execution with suppression; branch = divergent execution (branchReFires seams re-fire, RFC 0140 G6).
